title: OciConfig
description: Configuration for the OCI (Oracle Cloud Infrastructure) cloud-burst Provisioner backend (ARC-13 / ADR-20, #432): where on OCI to burst ephemeral compute nodes, how to size and price them, and how each node joins the cluster. Mirrors the Azure reference (azure_config.schema.json) / GCP (gcp_config.schema.json) via the CLI pattern. Mirrored by zetta::OciConfig in include/zetta/oci_provisioner.hpp and enforced by OciConfig::from_json() in src/core/oci_provisioner.cpp — keep them in sync. No cloud SDK lives behind the provisioner; this config is interpreted by an OciControlPlane (the reference OciCliControlPlane shells out to the `oci` CLI, the Instance Pool + preemptible shape). A malformed config is rejected at the boundary so a misconfigured burst fails fast instead of bringing up the wrong (or no) fleet.

compartment_id.description: The OCI compartment OCID the burst pool is created in.

availability_domain.description: The availability domain the instances run in (e.g. 'Uocm:PHX-AD-1').

subnet_id.description: The subnet OCID burst nodes attach their primary VNIC to.

region.description: The OCI region (e.g. 'us-ashburn-1'). Optional; omitted leaves the region to the CLI profile / config.

pool_name.description: Display name of the burst pool (the Instance Pool). Stable so a re-burst resizes the existing pool (resolved by name) rather than creating a duplicate. Defaults to 'zetta-burst' when omitted.

shape.description: The compute shape each node uses (e.g. 'VM.Standard.E5.Flex', 'VM.GPU.A10.1'). Defaults to 'VM.Standard.E5.Flex'.

ocpus.description: OCPUs per node for a flexible shape (the shapeConfig). 0 omits the shapeConfig (for fixed shapes). Default 1.

memory_in_gbs.description: Memory in GB per node for a flexible shape (the shapeConfig). 0 omits it. Default 16.

image_id.description: The image OCID burst nodes boot from. Empty lets the control plane / instance configuration default apply (a production deployment supplies a current platform/custom image OCID).

spot.description: Burst preemptible capacity — cheaper, interruptible — rather than on-demand nodes (the instance configuration's preemptibleInstanceConfig).

seed_peer.description: The cluster seed address (host:port) injected into each node's cloud-init (user_data) so it auto-joins the existing peer cluster at boot. Empty when the join address is supplied another way.
